name: Ingco HPWR15028 1500W 100-Bar Compact High Pressure Washer
shortDescription: Portable 1500W 100-bar high pressure cleaner with auto-stop system, adjustable spray pattern, and soap bottle attachment for workshop and vehicle cleaning.
overview: The Ingco HPWR15028 is a compact, highly portable electric high pressure washer designed for workshop washbays, garage mechanics, and light industrial maintenance tasks. Featuring a 1500W motor paired with an axial wobble-plate pump, it delivers 100 bar (1450 PSI) of operating pressure with a consistent 6.0 litre per minute flow rate. The ergonomic spray lance features an adjustable fan nozzle that shifts from a concentrated needle jet to a gentle 60-degree wash pattern. An intelligent Auto-Stop sensor automatically cuts power when the trigger is released, reducing pump wear and power consumption.
keyFeatures: 1500W pure copper motor delivering up to 100 Bar peak pressure
Max flow rate of 6.0 Litres/min (360 L/h) for fast washing and rinsing
Integrated Auto-Stop system preserves motor and pump life between trigger presses
Adjustable spray lance transitions from pinpoint jet to broad fan spray with a twist
Includes snap-on detergent bottle dispenser for foaming car shampoo or degreaser
Lightweight compact chassis with convenient top carry handle and cord wrap
Quick-connect water inlet with reusable stainless steel mesh filter
applications: Washing commercial pickup trucks, utility vans, and motorcycles
Cleaning air conditioning outdoor condenser coils and fins
Washing shop floors, grease pits, and oil drip trays
Hosing down factory shutter doors, window sills, and patio slabs
specsSummary: Power Input: 1500 Watts | Voltage: 220 V – 240 V, 50/60 Hz
